Onboarding

## Onboard your AI agent like a human teammate.

Upload your existing runbooks and SOPs. The agent understands business intent and starts executing immediately, reading your instructions, not running rigid code.

Ingests Natural Language

Reads your SOPs like a human would, applying logic and context to every task.

Collaborates on Edge Cases

When unsure, it engages your team via Slack, Teams, or Email to resolve ambiguity without stalling.

Real-Time Upskilling

Every correction is captured. The agent updates its instructions on the fly. No retraining cycle.

![Onboarding analysis chat showing invoice extraction with threshold dialog](https://nanonets.com/illustrations/agents/onboarding-mockup.png?dpl=dpl_2SKVeDs8QaJgRScDFrEi2DqDPJKm)

Transparency

## Finally, AI thatshows its work.

Verifiable Work: Every extracted field links back to its source. Side-by-side citations you can audit.

Context Awareness: Agents see the document inline while working, preserving full context end-to-end.

Intelligent Comparison: Discrepancies between documents or versions are surfaced automatically.
